status: unexecuted review expectations; not conformance results

scenarios.given: Real canonical signed native entries admitted cold and as a suffix from the exact base.
scenarios.expect: Same request/entry identities and duplicate inventories; each new actor signature checked once; no old actor signature recheck on warm extension.

scenarios.given: Same canonical unsigned intent, second different valid low-S signature.
scenarios.expect: One original receipt core and first stored signed entry; no second entry or consent evaluation.

scenarios.given: Known unsigned intent CID delivered with invalid signature.
scenarios.expect: Structural refusal before receipt lookup; no new identity consumed.

scenarios.given: Reuse signer/nonce while varying principal, grant CID, epoch, execution, operation kind or payload individually.
scenarios.expect: Exact-CID miss followed by tuple conflict; no append or new ineffective outcome.

scenarios.given: Reuse nonce under a different signer, app or genesis.
scenarios.expect: Distinct namespace and separately evaluated intent; unrelated key cannot consume victim namespace.

scenarios.given: Alternate key encoding or nonce length other than 16 bytes.
scenarios.expect: Canonical wire refusal before lookup; no split namespace.

scenarios.given: Repeat identical complete accountOperation after descriptor already consumed.
scenarios.expect: Return original receipt before descriptor-consumption check; no second authority operation.

scenarios.given: Suffix repeats exact unsigned request, tuple or consumed descriptor from complete prior prefix.
scenarios.expect: Invalid history; no extension publication, new floor or domain outcome.

scenarios.given: Two staged entries repeat exact unsigned request, tuple or descriptor.
scenarios.expect: Invalid history before atomic publication; staged first row does not leak into accepted owner.

scenarios.given: Checkpoint deferred mode lacks an old tuple and suffix appears new.
scenarios.expect: Explicit incomplete prior coverage; no prior absence or writer readiness; audit may later detect duplicate.

scenarios.given: Complete asserted tables and valid suffix, without genesis audit.
scenarios.expect: Asserted complete uniqueness with checkpoint dependence; no independently replayed or ordering-writer capability.

scenarios.given: P4 DATA parses successfully, copied shape presented as an accepted prefix.
scenarios.expect: No genuine prefix capability; caller misuse/refusal, no accepted floor or append.

scenarios.given: App descriptor/context paths verify; required nested participant proof content is missing.
scenarios.expect: Ordering/index head may advance; interpreted frontier stalls exactly; descriptor consumed only as verified reference, no claimed I1 acceptance or authority effect.
scenarios.requiredEvidence: Real retained descriptor and removed nested block

scenarios.given: Required selected-root entry or descriptor path has a missing MST/block.
scenarios.expect: Recover same-root bytes or bounded restart; no new verified head and no fabricated absence.

scenarios.given: Exact nested proof recovered and exposes invalid signature or context.
scenarios.expect: Fail closed, retain contradiction and known floors, stop lineage promotion; no fold denial or silent rollback.
scenarios.requiredEvidence: Actual invalid native or identity proof

scenarios.given: Verified activation source content unavailable, later exact bytes restored.
scenarios.expect: Same entry resumes; coherent state/source/authority/outcomes match healthy cold replay.

scenarios.given: Publish valid next entries, then read an earlier genuine fixed view.
scenarios.expect: Ignore rows above that view boundary; unchanged logical lookup and coverage answers.

scenarios.given: Candidate verified from genuine base A; current view advances to B before publish.
scenarios.expect: Reject stale publication or safely revalidate from B; no row insertion, floor regression or overwritten state.

scenarios.given: Copied base or empty suffix used to claim acceptance of a new selected root.
scenarios.expect: No acceptance; genuine delta-zero update still authenticates root/genesis/head/boundary.

scenarios.given: Current root retains tip but changes an older interior record.
scenarios.expect: Prefix reuse states its narrower policy; explicit current-map audit catches the changed historical path.

scenarios.given: Lower revision or equal revision with different root, preserving all known app histories.
scenarios.expect: Full selected-root recovery may accept under I1; preserve every pair-scoped app floor and do not invent an app position.

scenarios.given: Full-export recovery selects a different root than incomplete diff.
scenarios.expect: Restart candidate under actual new root; no mixed-root lookup result or proof relabelling.

scenarios.given: Complete index points to original content or receipt proof now unavailable.
scenarios.expect: Recover exact content/proof or return unavailable; no fabricated receipt, guessed conflict or second append.

scenarios.given: Lost reply reconciled with a later authenticated root proving identical entry.
scenarios.expect: Same immutable request/position/entry; new package names actual later root, original package remains unchanged.

scenarios.given: Exact recorded request retried after revoke, epoch reset, grant renewal or action activation.
scenarios.expect: Return historical receipt and available historical outcome without evaluating new authority; missing old outcome is unavailable.

scenarios.given: CAS loss, refresh or grant renewal occurs for retained queued bytes.
scenarios.expect: Original nonce/signature/grant/execution bytes unchanged; explicit replacement alone creates fresh nonce and signature.

scenarios.given: State generation changes while selective outcome read awaits storage.
scenarios.expect: Return a result bound to captured pinned generation or reject stale publication; never combine generations.

scenarios.given: Missing outcome at or before frontier versus beyond frontier.
scenarios.expect: Older missing result unavailable or promised-coverage integrity fault; only beyond frontier awaits interpretation.

scenarios.given: Trusted committed generation contains complete original history and indexes.
scenarios.expect: Bounded O(N) rederive/compare both access paths and descriptors; no old actor crypto/fold recheck; retain explicit reused provenance.

scenarios.given: Wrong app/genesis, pointer, extra row, gap, descriptor or outcome inventory in stored generation.
scenarios.expect: No accepted restore capability or append readiness; preserve higher known floors and recover.

scenarios.given: Same semantic CID but changed installed bytes/dependencies or copied provenance document.
scenarios.expect: No state reuse without checked actual target and exact accepted directed equivalence decision; otherwise replay.
scenarios.requiredEvidence: Installed Node and trusted browser adapter

scenarios.given: Crash/abort before and after native CAS and local generation commit, including lost native success reply.
scenarios.expect: Restore old or new coherent local generation, reconcile confirmed native suffix before new writes, no missing-row absence assumption.
scenarios.requiredEvidence: Reference PDS plus SQLite and Chromium

scenarios.given: Two writers use one native base for same intent and for distinct intents.
scenarios.expect: Native swapCommit arbitrates; loser refreshes, identical intent returns original receipt, distinct intent may append after fresh preflight.

scenarios.given: Local quota prevents commit or active reader/audit pins block reclamation.
scenarios.expect: No partial current view or accidental unpin; explicit unavailable/local resource failure; release and retry preserves exact bytes.

scenarios.given: Confirmed receipt establishes a floor above local verified prefix, followed by stale read.
scenarios.expect: Persist higher floor without manufacturing prefix acceptance; stale read cannot lower it; bridge before append.

scenarios.given: Fixed-target checkpoint audit completes while live suffix has advanced.
scenarios.expect: Upgrade only exact audited target/related validated generation; no unrelated assurance upgrade or silent newer-floor overwrite.
